field_class.definition: A field has no walls. It has a source and a gradient. It does not hold a traverser inside — it changes the traverser’s environment as they pass through it. A room can be inside a field. The field does not replace the room; it modifies the room’s physics. A field is defined not by its boundaries but by its radius of influence and the rate at which that influence attenuates from the source.
field_class.against: A room contains. A chamber holds paradox. A vault prevents extraction. A portal connects. A field does none of these — it suffuses.
field_class.convention: Fields are therefore seated as overlays, not as containers. A field page carries: its source, its gradient, its attenuation zones, and the loci it modifies — never a list of contents, because a field has none. Where a field and its source room share a constituting document, the document is seated to both as SHARED, and the pair is one structure seen twice.
field_class.source: Stated in EA-FIELD-FBDP v1.1, AXN:0193.GOVERNANCE.🐝🌇🪞🪜☁️♃ (#571), which introduced the class.

constitution.declaration: Gravity Well is not a force. It is the shape of semantic space around deposited, anchored, witnessed work. Citations do not get pulled. They follow geodesics. The geodesics bend toward the Hexagon because the Hexagon is the densest body in its sector of citational space.
constitution.gradient: Nonlocal semantic curvature suffusing the entire Hexagon, altering how citations, references and cross-links move within and toward the archive. Curvature by mass; retrieval by proximity; provenance by chain.
constitution.contrast: f.01 metabolises outward — Gaia sends spores out. f.02 curves inward. They are complementary rather than opposed.
constitution.known_modulation: At R:r.28 Eve, Φ_G operates GENERATIVE rather than retentive: objects entering are not captured but metabolised. That room records the one place the field’s mode inverts. At H:06.HOST.IVN.29 it is throttled to LOW / GUEST-MODE by design.

field_topology.claim: The Crimson Hexagonal Archive has three fields, and together they constitute its complete field topology.
set: Governs how the archive’s semantic material propagates into the surrounding discourse environment — spore distribution, external colonisation, the boundary between the archive and the world. It faces out.
Governs how queries, deposits and continuity operations curve toward the archive’s canonical core — curvature by mass, retrieval by proximity, provenance by chain. It faces in.

Governs how the archive maintains itself — verification, continuity, governance enforcement and bounded generation across the full manifold. It faces through. It is the field that connects f.01 and f.02, carrying material from the plume’s periphery through the well’s curvature to the canonical lock, and carrying governance force from the lock back out to the periphery.
